items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
STATE / GOALS
- Wednesday, Spring 3, Year 1, rain. Latest observed time 8:00 pm, outside Stardrop Saloon. No purchases made. Introductions last verified at 17/28 (11 remain) before the current Clint conversation; progress after it has NOT been checked.
- Current interaction: right-clicked a dark-haired resident outside the saloon; dialogue identified him as Clint, who mentioned exploring the mines. A left-click at approximately (0.571, 0.877) was then executed to advance dialogue. No subsequent screenshot, so whether the dialogue advanced/closed is UNKNOWN.
- Broad goal: continue introductions without purchases. Vincent introduced at 17/28. Jodi was spoken to but not confirmed as a new introduction. Maru, Sebastian and Haley introductions remain unconfirmed. Sam’s bedroom, Haley’s bedroom, and Jodi/Kent’s bedroom are friendship-restricted; entering those rooms is not needed for introductions.

RECENT ROUTE / LOCATIONS
- Beach pier route: from Willy’s fish shop, clear decking runs west across its front, then north beside the shop to the beach. The beach exit is north through vegetation-lined path and across a stone bridge; it reaches a town path and graveyard-side paved walkway. Map labels area Pelican Beach.
- Southwest houses: the sun-decorated house is Haley’s; farmer entered with W+X. Haley’s north-wall bedroom is friendship-restricted. Blue house nearby contains Jodi and Vincent; Jodi and Vincent were found in shared kitchen. Vincent introduction was completed and journal advanced 16/28 to 17/28. Jodi/Kent’s bedroom is friendship-restricted. Another room is Sam’s, also friendship-restricted. No need to recheck these doors.
- From blue house, exit south to stone walkway and travel east/north around lamps to central paving. Map identified Stardrop Saloon southeast of clinic, open noon–midnight. Saloon was reached by going southeast around the plaza/building; its sign was visibly identified. At 8 pm, Clint appeared on the path immediately south of farmer outside saloon. Current location should be re-observed after dialogue.

CONTROLS / LEARNED MECHANICS
- WASD cardinal; combinations diagonal. Movement duration is unreliable: even short presses may overshoot. Re-observe frequently; camera shifts invalidate old coordinates. Obstacles include walls, furniture, NPCs, vegetation, rocks and fences.
- Right-click nearby NPC reliably initiated conversation with Vincent and Clint; X can interact when close/facing, but may fail if alignment/distance is wrong. Movement+X successfully entered houses. Speech bubble alone does not prove a greeting. Dialogue advances with left-click; sometimes click once for text to finish and again to advance/close. Indicator location varies; full-width restriction message indicator was near (0.97, 0.89).
- F opens journal when not fishing; journal listed Introductions. Click entry to inspect count. Escape closes menus. M toggles map; hover locations for name/hours. E inventory, Social tab is heart icon.
- Fishing experiment: Bamboo Pole selected in slot 8. Holding C about 1.8s showed segmented charge gauge; subsequent cast completed. Brief C retrieved active lines without visible catch. Multiple casts showed only ripples, no distinct bite/gauge/catch; fishing remains unlearned. During active cast F did not open journal, but did after retrieval. Fishing is not the current priority.
- 4 pickaxe, 5 scythe, 8 Bamboo Pole. Tool targeting matters; cursor over target before C/left-click. Earlier energy tooltip showed 224/270, but current energy unknown.

OTHER VERIFIED NOTES
- Wednesday, Spring 3; latest observed time 8 pm. Rain. Starting money after Joja rescue charge was 450g; current amount unverified. Willy’s beach visit quest completed/removed from journal after receiving Bamboo Pole.
- Farmhouse/mailbox east road is easier than debris-heavy southern route. East from farm onto fenced road, then continue east (not north) to town stone walkway.
- Do not infer Clint introduction progress until closing/finishing dialogue and checking journal.
